# hetznerrobot_failover (Data Source)

Reads one failover IP and where it is routed to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hetznerrobot_failover" "vip" {
  ip = "88.99.1.10"
}

output "vip_target" {
  value = data.hetznerrobot_failover.vip.active_server_ip
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) Failover IP, or net address of a failover subnet.

### Read-Only

- `active_server_ip` (String) Main IP of the server the failover IP is routed to; null when unrouted.
- `netmask` (String) Netmask of the failover IP.
- `server_ip` (String) Main IP of the server the failover IP was ordered for.
- `server_ipv6_net` (String) Main IPv6 net of that server.
- `server_number` (Number) Number of that server.
